criteria.requirement: Add Binder.bindings_snapshot(*,include_parents=True) returning frozen BindingInfo tuples for existing effective bindings only: interface, provider_type, scope, owner_depth, explicit and immutable multi-contribution provider/scope type metadata. Preserve child-over-parent precedence and current registration order, mark ImplicitBinding accurately and inspect _bindings directly under existing lock without get_binding/auto_bind/provider invocation. Never expose mutable Binding objects or business instances; later rebind does not mutate prior snapshots, and include_parents must be actual bool. Special ProviderOf/AssistedBuilder capabilities must not be auto-created merely by inspection.
